chunks: The expiation for working for the ruler is fulfilling the needs of the brothers.

key_terms.كَفَّارَةُ: expiation; a means of morally compensating for or atoning for something

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for working for the ruler according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that involvement in the service of political authority carries a moral burden that requires expiation. He states that this expiation is to fulfill the needs of fellow believers, linking public service and worldly occupation to responsibility toward the community.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3666 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The expiation for working for the ruler is fulfilling the needs of the brothers."
